subject.title: [Feature]: Add TTL/Expiry for Delivery Queue Messages

question: Should outbound delivery expiry be opt-in or enabled by default, and should an expired entry be terminalized as failed, deleted, or remain pending?
rationale: Each choice changes the reliability contract and persisted-state behavior: replaying favors at-least-once delivery, while expiration prevents stale or duplicate channel floods but can suppress legitimate delayed messages.

options.title: Opt-in terminal expiry
options.body: Add an optional maximum age and move expired entries to the existing failed/quarantine path with clear logs, preserving current replay behavior for existing configurations.

options.title: Default bounded expiry
options.body: Enable a maintained default maximum age for all users and document the intentional upgrade-time change from indefinite replay to terminal expiration.

options.title: No TTL surface
options.body: Keep indefinite recovery and instead pursue stronger acknowledgement or idempotency tracking so already-delivered messages are not replayed.

recommendation.title: Opt-in terminal expiry
recommendation.body: Add an optional maximum age and move expired entries to the existing failed/quarantine path with clear logs, preserving current replay behavior for existing configurations.
